name: @agent-runtime-sidecar/edge-worker
description: Browser edge-worker SDK for Agent Runtime Sidecar: registers a web page as a durable Worker and runs a local device-capture agent.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node -e "require('node:fs').writeFileSync('dist-es/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'module'}))"
scripts.clean: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('fs').rmSync('dist-es', { recursive: true, force: true }); require('fs').rmSync('dist-tests', { recursive: true, force: true })"
